🆕 NEW RELEASE: Mayday Parade share shelved song All Your Friends

Mayday Parade have shared "All Your Friends", a song tracked during the 2025 Sweet sessions and held back at the time. It leads the deluxe edition of Sweet, Sad, Sugar, which gathers all three mini albums and is due on 4 December 2026.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Deryck Whibley announces 2027 solo tour of Sum 41 songs

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Basement confirm Wired Tour across Europe and the UK

Basement have booked the Wired Tour for February 2027, running from Amsterdam on 2 February to Dublin on 22 February. Germany gets five dates in Munich, Berlin, Hamburg, Leipzig and Cologne, and the London Roundhouse show is billed as their biggest headline date yet.
